query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, mp.module, mp.accessLevel, mp.canAccess, mp.canEdit, mp.canCreate
FROM user u
LEFT JOIN modulePermissions mp ON u.id = mp.userId
WHERE u.name LIKE '%kirolos%' OR u.email LIKE '%kirolos%'
ORDER BY u.id, mp.module;
